tasks.contract: Serial chain identified (g6lc_iq.sv:227-257): lane p nused[b]=popcount(earlier pick_oh & valid) -> elig=ge[nused+1] -> rot/rotr(hint) -> pick_r=rot&-rot -> rotl unrotate -> asgn -> disp_ack=back&&group_fits. Depth ~NP x (lookup+rotate+isolate+unrotate) ~ 36 FO4 at NP=8. Serial dependency is ONLY pick_oh[p]->nused[p+1]; per-lane popcount already parallel. Candidate: resolve per-bank assignment by bounded enumeration over bank capacity (free[b] small) OR k-th-free-choice per bank preserving low/high tie + starvation policy; translate_off ref_steer (g6lc_iq.sv:263-283) is the built-in equivalence oracle. Must preserve: group-wide acceptance (group_fits), intra-group allocation order, bank capacity, dead-lane skip (pick_oh[j]&disp_valid_i[j]), hold winning entry+identity through backpressure/wakeup/cancel/ready-requalify -- no grant without retained payload. || DEEPER (this pass): Hyp8 binds IqBanks=8, IqBankEntries=4, NP=8 -> BANKS=8 pow2, bank_free<=4, ge[k][b]=bank_free[b]>=k precomputed. Serial chain is NP-deep: pick_oh[p]->nused[p+1]->elig->rotr/rotl->pick_oh[p+1] (~4-5 FO4/stage). Exact serial-dictatorship has no O(1) parallel form. Candidate structures ranked: (a) PIPELINED STEER inside existing grp_v_q hold -- cycle1 register per-lane hint-ordered eligibility prefs, cycle2 resolve picks+allocs while group still held (+1 alloc latency, no throughput loss, satisfies no-grant-without-payload); requires dispatch caller proof that grp_v_q/iqi_take hold covers the extra cycle and back[b] payload is registered not comb-dependent. (b) distance-encoded priority pick replacing rotr/rotl barrel shifts ((b-hint)&7 subtract bank + 8-way min-dist encoder) -- shortens stage ~2 FO4 but keeps NP depth, insufficient alone. (c) BANKS=2 specialization rejected: config binds 8. ref_steer translate_off oracle already instantiated for equivalence.
